title: Great for eating, doesn't fit easily in my cabinet
text:
Great for eating, doesn't fit easily in my cabinet. pros : great idea. Perfect for korean food because we have some side dishes when eating. Cleaning is easy. Material has a nice feel.
Cons: it doesn't fit so well in my cabinet. Its a pain to stack with any other type of plate or bowl.
What I would improve on would be if the sides are able to come out and click into place. So you can control the size of the side plates and it would be easy to store into plate cabinets.
